flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/schedulers/CesUploadJobsScheduler, framework/workflows/agencies/ces/jobs/CesGenerateFileJob, framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findCertisForeignVehicleNotices), utilities/ces/CesWantedVehiclesDatGenerator; resources cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties. ocmsadminui: tagged-vehicle route and menu are commented out. No DOS, EPS operator, or warrant-of-arrest ID selection code.
note: Story status is blank in stories.json and no extra requirement is given; assessed from the story text. The story wants OCMS to receive the latest vehicle numbers per ID with outstanding warrants of arrest from DOS, build a daily file, and send it to the frontend enforcement systems and EPS operators. Only the CES 'Wanted Vehicle' file exists: a daily 00:05 cron (cron.cesupload.enabled=true in prod, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties:207-208) builds CES_WANTED_VEHICLES_*.DAT from unpaid foreign-vehicle PS/FOR notices older than X days (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:306-324) and sends it encrypted through COMCRYPT and SFTP (sftp.enabled=true, disabledServers=toppan, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/application-prod.properties:82-86). The content comes from notice status, not from warrant IDs or DOS results, so file generation and delivery are Sebagian at most (same as OCMS33.4 and OCMS33.5). There is no DOS integration (DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo), no selection of IDs with warrants (Court module not built, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:727), and the word EPS does not appear in code. The real server property values, the ocms_parameter FOR/PERIOD value, and receipt at CES/EPS cannot be verified from the repo. Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-150 (CES upload cron bug fix, In SIT, not closed) touches the SMS alert of this job, not the file content.
recommendation: Claim only Sebagian for the daily file build and delivery to CES. Do not claim receiving data from DOS, warrant ID selection, or delivery to EPS operators

steps.step: OCMS receives the latest vehicle numbers for IDs with outstanding warrants of arrest from DOS
steps.detail: There is no client, endpoint, or cron that receives data from DOS. The word DOS appears only in the staff screen 'DOS Reports' (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportListDOS.tsx:82), which calls the dosvaultrecords resource with no controller in any repo, and its tab is commented out (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx:162-166). DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. The existing DataHive batches fetch NRIC/FIN/UEN data, not vehicle numbers per warrant ID.

steps.step: OCMS selects the IDs that have outstanding warrants of arrest
steps.detail: There is no query or job that selects IDs by warrant. The Warrant Description column in the Toppan file is deliberately blank with the comment 'Court module not ready for MVP1' (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:727). In ocmsadminapi there is only an authorization entry /v1/warrantofarrest (ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:23) with no controller, and the UI only has an Iwarrantofarrest model for notice search. Same as OCMS33.5.

steps.step: OCMS generates a daily file with the latest vehicle numbers per ID
steps.detail: The CES cron at 00:05 runs daily (cron.cesupload.enabled=true, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties:207-208; ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/schedulers/CesUploadJobsScheduler.java:43-52) and builds CES_WANTED_VEHICLES_*.DAT (header, one detail per vehicle, trailer; ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/utilities/ces/CesWantedVehiclesDatGenerator.java:115-117). But the content comes from a query of unpaid foreign-vehicle PS/FOR notices (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:306-324 via ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl.java:53), not from vehicle numbers per warrant ID. The daily file mechanism exists but its data source differs from the story. The repo prod properties say true; the real server value cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS sends the daily file to the frontend enforcement systems
steps.detail: The CES file is uploaded to blob, encrypted via COMCRYPT, and sent by SFTP (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl.java:104-109). Prod properties: sftp.enabled=true, sftp.upload.allowedSources includes COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_CES, disabledServers=toppan only (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/application-prod.properties:82-86), so CES is not switched off. What is sent is the Wanted Vehicle file built from notice status, not a DOS list, and CES is only one system; no other enforcement system was found. Same as OCMS33.4. The real server values and receipt at CES cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS sends the daily file to the EPS operators
steps.detail: The term EPS (as an operator) does not appear in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, or thirdpartyapi (grep EPS only matches other words). There is no job or SFTP destination for EPS. The only destination of the daily vehicle file is the ces server (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl.java:104-109).
